scientific_integrity: Every infinite assertion is established by a rational-inequality and multiplicative-order proof; bounded enumeration independently checks cases but is not used to infer universal truth.
scientific_limitations: Only 2-adic valuations \(a\in\{1,2\}\) and three distinct prime divisors; no priority claim for the five known numerical examples; unindexed proofs remain a priority risk.
title: The first two dyadic layers of the three-prime divisor-sum/totient equation
